lessons.title: Telling the Time

items.example: Que horas são agora?
São duas horas da tarde.
items.exampleMeaning: It is two o'clock in the afternoon.

items.example: A festa começa à meia-noite.
É meia hora depois das cinco.
items.exampleMeaning: It is half an hour after five.

items.example: São quatro horas e quinze minutos.
Eu chego em dez minutos.

lessons.tip: In Brazilian Portuguese, when asking for the time, you say 'Que horas são?'. To express time, use 'são' for all times except one o'clock, which uses 'é'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: E você chega em dez minutos?
dialogue.meaning: And you arrive in ten minutes?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, eu chego em dez minutos.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I arrive in ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: A festa começa à meia-noite, certo?
dialogue.meaning: The party starts at midnight, right?

scenario.partnerRole: A friend who wants to know the time and details about an event.
scenario.learnerRole: You are the person with the time and event information.
scenario.brief: Answer questions about the time and when the party starts. Use the phrases from this lesson.
scenario.goal: You should be able to tell the time and give information about arriving.

lessons.title: Buying Tickets

items.example: Eu quero um bilhete, por favor.
Onde fica a bilheteira da estação?
items.exampleMeaning: Where is the ticket office at the station?

items.example: Quantos bilhetes você precisa?
items.exampleMeaning: How many tickets do you need?

items.example: Para onde você vai?
O bilhete custa dez reais.

items.text: Eu quero um bilhete de ida.
items.example: Eu quero um bilhete de ida para São Paulo.
items.exampleMeaning: I want a one-way ticket to São Paulo.

lessons.tip: When buying tickets, you can say 'Um bilhete, por favor' to request a ticket. Always remember to specify your destination and whether you want a one-way or round-trip ticket.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: It is over there, near the entrance.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How many tickets do you need?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eu quero um bilhete, por favor.

scenario.partnerRole: A person at the transport station.
scenario.brief: Ask for the location of the ticket office and the cost of a ticket. Use the phrases from this lesson.
scenario.goal: You should be able to request a ticket and understand the cost.

lessons.title: Present Tense Verbs

items.example: Eu vou ao trabalho de ônibus.
items.exampleMeaning: I go to work by bus.

items.example: Você faz a lição de casa?
Ela estuda português.
Nós viajamos para o Brasil.
Eles trabalham no escritório.
Eu quero ir ao cinema.
items.exampleMeaning: I want to go to the cinema.

lessons.tip: In Brazilian Portuguese, the present tense is formed by changing the verb endings. For example, 'ir' (to go) becomes 'vou' for 'I go'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você faz a lição de casa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nós viajamos para o Brasil em julho.
dialogue.meaning: We travel to Brazil in July.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Great! I want to go too.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, ele estuda todos os dias.

scenario.partnerRole: A friend who is discussing travel plans.
scenario.learnerRole: You are sharing your study and travel plans.
scenario.brief: Talk about your homework and travel plans using present tense verbs.
scenario.goal: You should be able to describe what you do and your plans.

lessons.title: Asking for Directions

items.example: Onde está a estação de trem?
Vire à direita na próxima esquina.
items.exampleMeaning: Turn right at the next corner.

items.example: Vire à esquerda na rua principal.
items.exampleMeaning: Turn left on the main street.

items.example: Siga em frente até a praça.
A estação está longe daqui?
items.exampleMeaning: Is the station far from here?

items.example: A farmácia é perto da sua casa.
items.exampleMeaning: The pharmacy is near your house.

lessons.tip: When asking for directions, start with 'Onde está...?' to find a place. Use 'vire' for turning and 'siga' for going straight.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Onde está a estação de trem?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Siga em frente até a praça.

scenario.brief: Help a person find the train station using the phrases from this lesson.
scenario.goal: You should be able to give clear directions.
